verdict.rationale: Docusign Web Forms offers guided, mobile-ready flows with conditional logic that can populate agreements (docusign-docs-19, docusign-docs-42), and CLM generates contracts from dynamic templates. Separately, CLM and AI-Assisted Review flag non-compliant clauses or risky language against playbooks (docusign-docs-41, docusign-docs-20, docusign-docs-25). These pieces sit in separate products and target enterprise legal teams, not founder-facing legal questionnaires. missing for 10: a ready-made legal document library for founders, questionnaire answers that flag specific choices for attorney review, evidence that questionnaire-filled documents are legally correct, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
